The '''D'Anjon Nebula''' was an expansive [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the northernmost part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. To the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] south of the nebula was the [[Star/Legends|starless]] void known as the [[Gulf of Tatooine/Legends|Gulf of Tatooine]].<ref name="TEA" />

The D'Anjon Nebula formed as a result of an ancient [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], and posed a [[Navigator/Legends|navigational]] hazard, with the young stars inside the nebula being [[Scout/Legends|unexplored]] and barely surveyed as a result.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The D'Anjon Nebula was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
